lines.text: the top floor. marble, glass, and the city lit below. everything up here was for sale, and all of it for show.
she was waiting for me, my bag on her knee, like a cat she'd been petting. it looked at me.

lines.speaker: madame
lines.text: "all this way for one little bag? how sweet. you must be tired, darling. take a seat."

lines.speaker: madame
lines.text: "everybody gets rugged, sweetie. that's just the game. it's nothing personal. you'd have done the same."
the call wasn't coming from far away. it came from the next room over, where she'd been all day.

lines.speaker: madame
lines.text: "let's play, cutie. don't be shy. first one to blink says goodbye."
she smiled like the game was already won. they always do, right up until it's done.
